# GitHub Copilot Instructions

Canonical instructions for this repository live in [../AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md).

When working in this repository:

- read [../AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) first
- treat `AGENTS.md` as the single source of truth
- use [../CODING.md](../CODING.md), [../WORKFLOWS.md](../WORKFLOWS.md), [../PERSONAS.md](../PERSONAS.md), and [../coding-standards/README.md](../coding-standards/README.md) only through that shared instruction model
- do not introduce a separate Copilot-specific rule set here unless the repo owner explicitly wants one
